program.name: Kettlebell Shuffle 35
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: One kettlebell, a new pairing every day, then a short finisher: about thirty-five minutes.
program.about: One kettlebell and thirty-five minutes, never the same twice. Each day deals complexes, swings, legs, presses, rows, hips, grip, full body or bell core, in a new format, then a short finisher: a Tabata, a core circuit or a quick bell lift after the cardio days. The same kind never lands two days running. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
program.split: Every day different · one kettlebell, 35 minutes, lift & finish
